infobox.usage: Unlocks a bedroom at the peninsula territory on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Lighthouse island stash key (Lighthouse) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to Lightkeeper's stash located in one of the houses on the lighthouse island.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter The Ticket

sections.heading: Key location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to a bedroom on the second floor of the house that is located next to the guard building at the lighthouse peninsula territory on Lighthouse. Note: The bridge that leads to the peninsula is guarded by Zryachiy and full of Claymores. To safely pass the bridge, an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter is required.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - Loose loot (Containers, Valuables, Weapon mods, , Stimulants)
